title: About Me
text:
Hi, I’m Gigi Goff. I have a background in biological sciences and hands-on research experience at Emory University, along with projects in bioinformatics and data analysis.
I’m passionate about connecting research, data, and writing to create meaningful impact — whether through managing biological samples, analyzing protein sequences, or communicating results clearly.
